tei:div.tei:p: lha dbang sprul pa dpal ldan shar dga'i byung tshul yod/

'gro kun dga' mdzad dpal ldan sa skya pas/ /mkhyen brtse'i thugs rje'i nam mkha' yangs pa las/ /shar ri'i rtse nas 'od stong 'bar ba bzhin// shar phyogs ldan ma las skyes shar dga' ba/ /rigs bzang khungs btsun lha dbang rnams 'phrul ltar/ /'ga' zhig phas rgol dpung 'joms dmag dpon rin chen dang*/ /ding sang bstan pa'i srog shing chos rgyal chen po'ang byon/ /des na bde bas thub bstan gsal byed dang*/ /mdzad pa'i rnam thar rgyal mtshan grangs mang yang*/ /ngo mtshar 'phrin las rags pa zur tsam bris/ /de yang dpal ldan shar dga' par grags 'di pa'i byon tshul ni/ rigs mtho ba/ sga ldan tre ho gsum gyi yul khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ jo bo'i rigs su gyur cing rus bzang ba/ bod mi'u drug gi nang nas/ dmu tsha lha'i gdung rgyud kyi nang tshan ldan ma'i bu rgyud ste/ dang po khri srong lde btsan gyis dus su/ ldan ma rtse mang zer ba'i/ sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po dang*/ ldan ma byang khri/ byang dmar la sogs/ ma sangs kyis sprul pa'ang mang du byon par 'dug cho 'brang btsun pa ni/ ldan stod sga'i yul du/ sga a snyan dam pa zer ba'i/ 'byor ldan dkar phyogs la mos pa byung 'dug pas/ de sga ldan tre bo'i sa phyogs su/ lha khang rgya phibs khyung mgo can brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha khang de'i nang du rten ngo mtshar can dang*/ bka' 'gyur ro cog cha tshang ma re re bzhengs pa'i drung du dkar me 'khor yugamachod pa rnams lnga'i rgyun ma bcad pa'i dge rgyun btsugs pa lags so// bstan pa dar rgyas 'phel ba'i bya ba chen mo mdzad 'dug de'i dbon sras kyis rgyud pa/ ldan ma dbon po bzang po rgyan mtshan man/ yab sras 'khor bcas kyis dbus gtsang dag pa zhing khams/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya bla ma'i/ spyan sngar byon par bzhed nas/ yar btegs byon pas/ mi shi ba lha ru song ba'i ldan ma dbang rgyal zhes par grags pa/ lha btsan bzang po gcig yod pa des/

rmi lam du lung rim par bstan pa bzhin/ gtsang g.yas ru'i ru lag bcung pa yu ba gdong*/ bzhi dga' gser sdings rnams su rim pas phyugs/ gser sdings su gzhi phab/ sras po de gzhon nu nas klog yig sogs yon tan dang ldan pas/ grong pa rnams kyang*/ dpon yig bzang po dpal 'dis/ rang re thams cad la phan thogs par byung zer cing*/ gnas po phyug po chen po zhig yod pa'ang*/ bu chung la zhe mgu nas/ nga'i bu mo dang bza' mi gyis shig zer nan gyis bskul bas/ bu mo lha mo sman dang*/ yab yum du 'brel/ lo 'ga' song ba dang*/ pha rgan sku gshegs/ der rting bu mo la rmi ltas bzang po byung nas/ bya lo la sras po zhig 'khrungs pa/ mtshan dpal ldan dar zhes par btags so// yang lha'i lung bstan la/ 'di nas shar lho phyogs kyis la rgyab ba'i pha rol der song zhig der nga'i 'dug gnas kyang 'chos la/ rten tshugs bya ba thams cad kyang yar 'phel du 'byung ngo zer ba byung nas/ yab yum sras kyis yar byon/ thar pa dgon sar/ lcam kla dpyal bla ston chos 'phags kyi drung du/ sras pho la dge bsnyen zhus/ bla ma'i mtshan las dras nas/ 'phags pa dpal bzang po zer ba'i mtshan btags/ 'phags pa'i ming can mi rabs bdun gyi bar la/ bstan jus mnga' thang yar 'phel du 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i bka' gnang*/ de nas lar rgan la byon ste/ bod mkhar sngon mo lung du bzhugs pa'i nub mo/ lha byon nas 'dir mkhar gzhis phob/ nga'i lha rten tshugs zer ba byung nas bzhugs pas/ lha yul sngon mo lung du grags pa byung ngo*/ /de'i skabs su/ yul pa rnams/ sa skyar 'dab skor 'bul du 'gro dus yig ris dgos pas grogs ldan la/ dpon yig bzang po dpal ba'i kyang*/ thengs 'ga' byon pas/ sa skya nas nang chen gyis yig mkhan la bskongs/ de nas yun ring ma 'gyangs par/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba'i drung du/ yig tshang pa'i mthil bzhugs thob/

thugs rjes bzung nas mnga' thang yar 'phel du byung zhing*/ ma cig lha mo sman la/ /sras po 'phags pa'i rin chen dang*/ ma sangs dar po dang*/ sngon mo lung du 'khrungs so/ /sras che ba la klog yig mkhas par bslabs/ gzhon nu nyid nas sa skya/ bla ma'i drung du skyabs/ ma sangs kyi sprul par song nas gzhan las 'khrungs bskyed che zhing*/ bya ba'i rnam dbye shin tu mkhas pa zhig byung bas/ khams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan rnams/ dung reng gi kha non dang sngags pa'i zla la/ yi ge shes pa zhig kyang dgos pa byung bas/ khong pa btang*/ khams pa mi bdun pos thog drangs rgan pa gong gsum bar dgar byas pa'i/ shar dga' bar grags pa de nas byung*/ khams pa rang bzhugs rin la'ang*/ dung reng gi kha non rab tu byung zhing*/ khong pa bon nag 'od chen du sku gshegs/ zhal chems bzhag pa bzhin/ dpon yig 'phags pa dpal ba/ dpon tshab tu khur/ mdun ma rtse gcig tu bsgril pa'i chad 'gag bsdams/ dpal ldan shar dga' ba'i bstan pa'i mgo sngon ma de nyid nas tshugs par byed do/ /gsum de mtshams dbus gtsang khri skor dmag gis dung reng la 'gag sgugamathar 'ded byed par bshams pa/ shar dung rnams ring ldan zur la 'chur/ khos pha rol nas gur sha'i ri phug la 'chur dus/ gong gsum gyis sgar pas mthar 'ded rtsis la/ dung reng dpon don grub dar gyi lam bskrad nas/ dpon 'phags pa dpal khyod bsam pa che na/ nged rnams la chas kha sbyin nas thongs/ zla ba rting ma la/ ngo lta sleb pa byed zer bas/ de'i phugs khebs che bar 'dug bsam nas/ gtsang mar btang bas sa skya nas nyes pa la thug pa khad tsam byung nas/ bzang chad byas lugs zhus pas/ zla dus la don grub dar gyis shar dung gis mi sna drag btus thams cad khrid/ mi khyod kyis bzang po byas phyin/ nga yang bzang po byed pa yin zer nas/ mi nor thams cad ngo bltas/ drag pa rnams las 'dzin la bcugagazhis chags nas/ dung reng gis mi rgyud/

myang stod na da lta'ang yod do/ /der rting phag ri rin chen sgang dang*/ lho spa gro ban 'phreng ba'i/ blon po grags pa 'od zer 'jam grengs skug gzhan slu rgod thams cad kha drangs nas lho dung thams cad btul/ nag che ba rnams kyi mgo lag rin chen sgang gi mgon khang*/ them 'og na yod/ der rting bla ma'i bka' bzhin/ phag ri rnam rgyal gyi rdzong brtsigs/ lho dung gis sa chad thams cad 'og tu bcugalas sgo che chung rnams btsugs rdzong dpon sngon ma la gcung po 'phags rin pa bskos/ de ltar shar dung*/ lho dung*/ rim par thul bas dpon jus dang*/ rang don grub pa shin tu che bar byung*/ de ltar sa skya nang chen gyis go sar yang lo 'ga' bzhugs shing*/ mi rtsag pa sag shi dar ra kha che/ ti shri kun rgyal bas phyag phyir gong du brdzangs/ hor rgyal po tho gan thi mur la zhus nas si tu'i mtshan dang*/ tham rtags 'ja' sa blangs/ sham po rtse dgu'i ldan la/ lha khang dang bde yangs chen mo bzhengs/ chos sde btab rdzong rtse chen zer bar ming btags/ rgyal mkhar gyis ri bsrung ba'i/ rtse khang dang*/ lcang ra/ brgya grong gis sa mkhar brtsigs/ der rting phag mo gru pa si tu byang rgyal ba dang*/ thugs nye 'brel zab po yod pas/ sne gdong du byon zer ba byung ba la/ thugs bkal nas byon pas/ si tu pa grongs pa dang thug bros pa rnams kyis/ bra phyi tshong 'dus su bzang btson la skong dus su phyag phyi ba/ dge slong shāka bzang dang*/ a po bkra hor/ yar klungs dge bsnyen la sogs/ dpon zhen can rnams kyi sems khur byas pas/ gtsang mar thon/ yar byon/ gnas rnying du bzhugs/ rtse chen lcang ra/ rgya grong nang na phag rin pa sku mched bzhugs pa la/ sne gdong nas nag po tshul bzang dang*/ pag shi dkon mchog skyabs/ mda' phog nas 'das pas/ dmag dpung bros thabs la phyir log dgos byung nas/ shar dga' ba'i bstan jus kyi gzhi gcig de nas tshugs par byed do/

/ta'i si tu 'phags pa dpal bzang po'i sras che ba/ nang chen kun dga' 'phags pas yong*/ rgyal mkhar rtse rdzong dang*/ 'dug chung gi sa mkhar bzhengs/ stag rtse rdzong phag mo gru pa'i lag nas blangs/ sa skya nang chen gyis khog par zhugs nas/ sde srid chen po'i bstan jus yar 'phel gyis mdzad 'phrin rgya che bar mdzad/ gcung po ta'i si tu bsod nams dpal bas/ rdzong rtse chen bzung*/ phyi nang du/ dgra zun gyi blang dor/ sde gzar ci rigs pa dgos pa byung na'ang*/ ma sangs kyi sprul pa/ thabs la mkhas pa'i skyes bu dpa' mdzangs 'dzoms 'dug pas/ mthar thug dgra gnyen blang dor ma nor pa'i 'dul sbyongs/ sa skya pa'i zhabs togaspyi jus su che ba dang*/ ma las bu dga' ba'i rdzong bzhi/ shab seng ge rtse/ sde chen rtse/ 'jad/ bo dong la sogs pa'i mnga' zhabs gsar 'phel rim par chod cing*/ rgya'i ta'i ming rgyal pos/ tu si'i mtshan/ dngul dam lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang nas/ dpal ldan sa skya pas thog drangs/ gtsang srid spyi dgos kyis bstan pa'i srog shing lta bur bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ /de'i sras che ba dpon po rgya mtsho pa/ sku na gzhon rab la sku gshegs/ gcung po dbon po rin chen 'phags pa la/ ta'i ming rgyal pos/ su si'i las ka gnang zhing*/ sde srid 'dzin skyong gis phra rags thams cad yab las mi zhan pa byung ba'i/ snyan grags yar 'phel du bzhugs so/ /'phags pa rin po che'i sras che ba/ rtse chen chos rje pa mdo rgyud kyis dgongs pa rnams thugs su chud ste/ rnal 'byor gyis dbang phyug chen po de nyid kyis 'gro ba'i 'dren pa la sku brtan par bzhugs so/ /de'i gcung po rgyal chen pa/ yang dpon po shākya dpal ba dang*/ chen po dbang rgyal bas/ sa skya nang chen bzung*/ nang ltar gyis mthun sbyor mdzad pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs rnams kyis spyi thogs su/ ri bo ltar brjid pa zhig byon par gda'o/ /yang ma sangs dar po'i sras/

a chen bzang po dpal ba yin cing*/ de'i sras dpon rin chen rgyan mtshan dpal ba dang*/ nor bu 'phags pa yin no/ /nang chen kun dga' 'phags pa'i sras/ mched gsum gyi che ba/ rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa myang stod rgya grong du/ ma gcig bzang mo dpal ba la/ sa mo sbrul lo 'byung ba lnga ldan gyi thog tu sku 'khrungs 'di nyid ni nges par byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa ste/ rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad 'phrin rgya che lugs ni brjod par mi nus kyis/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rags pa tsam zhig khrims gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan par bya ba ni/ dang por sku gzhon nu'i dus su zhi dul dang ldan pa sogs/ chos mthun gyis yon tan du mas mdzes shing*/ dgung lo bcu gsum bcu bzhi nas/ sems dpa' pa chen po chos kyi rin chen gyi zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs/ rjes su bzung*/ nyi shu ba la yab mes khu dbon pas thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir sgrub mchod chen mo'i gzhi btsugs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la yab dang yum gyis sku drin bsab pa'i phyir/ sgrub mchod yun ring dang gzhi rten bzang po btsugs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la mkhyen rab kyis mnga' bdag dge legs dpal bas thog drangs/ lung rigs smra ba brgya phrag bzhi lhag 'du ba'i lcang ra chos kyis gzhi bting*/ nyi shu rtsa drug pa la/ myang chu la zam chen bkag che dang bcas pa bzhengs/ sum cu pa la gos sku chen mo ston pa'i sku khru brgyad cu pa dang*/ der rting gser 'phan chen mo'i dbus na/ byams pa'i sku khru bzhi bcu pa dang*/ gzhan yang gos dar la khru bdun cu re yod pa'i 'phan brgyad rnams bzhengs/ rdo rje gdan gyis mkhan po/ ma hā so ma sogs rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta du ma spyan drangs/ bdag rkyen bzang po mdzad/ der rting yang bstan pa'i bdag po de nyid kyis thugs la/ sems can gyis bde skyid sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa la rag las/ bstan pa'i gsal byed/ lung rtogs thos bsam la rag las 'dug pas/

bstan pa dar zhing yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa zhig kyang bzhengs dgos dgongs pa byung nas/ thub pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum stong lnga brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum song ba'i/ sa pho khyi lo la mnga' bdag dpal khri btsan gyi pho brang rgya gar rtse'i nye 'khor la sogs su/ chos grwa chen mo dpal 'khor bde chen/ gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa'i 'gram bting*/ lung rigs smra ba brgya phrag bcu dang*/ rim gnyis zab mo la brtson pa brgya phrag lnga tsam/ rtse gcig sgrub pa la brtson pa brgya phrag la sogs/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i sde btsugs dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas/ gtsang khang ka chen brgyad/ rnam par sgo gsum/ khyams ka ba bzhi cu zhe brgyad kyi sa/ yongs su ka ba lnga bcu khyon/ gse 'phru khru nyi shu lnga pa/ rten gyi gtso bor rdo rje gdan gyi mahā bo dhi'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i byang chub chen po'i sku'i thog drangs/ steng 'og gi lha khang thams cad nas gser sku/ lder sku gzhal yas khang blos bslangs la sogs bris legs pa ngo mtshar can gyis yongs su gang bar bzhugs cing*/ rten gtso'i spyan snga na/ gser kong*/ dngul kong*/ maṇḍal chen mos thog drangs/ lha khang spyir dgos kun na/ mar me 'khor yug dang*/ mchod pa'i rgyun phun sum tshogs pa btsugs/ dgung lo so bdun pa la lcags ri chen mo/ lcog nyi shu sgo chen brgyad/ phyi ljon shing gis ra bas bskor ba dang bcas pa bzhengs/ so dgu pa la sku 'bum chen po bkra shis sgo mang kyi 'gram bting nas/ yun ma 'gyangs par zhabs su chug de rting byams chen gyis gos sku khru brgyad cu pa zhig bzhengs/ rin po che'i bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur bzhengs shing bskor ba dang*/ gzung sngags mang po'i bzlas brjod rgyun pa btsugs/ phu ru sgrub pa po brgya rtsa brgyad bzhugs pa'i/ ri khrod dga' ldan gyis 'gram bting*/

'di ltar bshad grwa sgom grwa 'dzugs pa/ rten lha khang bzhengs pa/ bod 'brog dge rgyun la sbyor ba/ mnga' zhabs la khral 'chag ster ba sogs/ dkar phyogs kyi mdzad 'phrin kho na gtso bor 'don cing*/ phun sum tshogs pa chen po bco brgyad dang*/ nye ba'i phun tshogs bco brgyad dang ldan pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba'i lam la bkod do/ /mi dbang de'i rnam thar thugs rgyud la| |'khrungs pa'i dge las byed dang byed 'gyur dang*/ /'gro la phan bde'i sgrub pa 'di ltas na/ /byams mgon sprul pa yin par kun gyi bsngags/ /zhes pa rnams chos khrims dar bar mdzad pa'i rnam thar zur tsam bkod pa'o/ /rgyal khrims bde bas bskyangs tshul ni/ gzhon nu nyid nas rtsa ba'i dpon yang*/ 'khon gyis gdung rgyud rin chen rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs/ yab khu bo bgres rim rnams gtsug tu khur/ bting 'jags thon/ rgya ta ming rgyal pos ta'i si tu'i mtshan dang*/ dngul dam lung gnang sbyin dang bcas pa gnang*/ stag tshang rdzong pa dang*/ dpon blon sngar las kyang nye bar 'brel nas/ mi dbang nam mkha' la sogs pa'i thugs sras su gyur cing*/ lte rtse rdzaung gis gnyer las bzung nas/ zhabs tog tshul bzhin du bsgrubs/ bzhi thog gdung rgyud pas/ sku phra mo nas/ mnga' zhabs byin dge ba la bskul cing*/ kun gyis chos rgyal chen mor mtshan gsol/ dpung mi lag tu zas nor gdangs nas/ ngal dub dang phangs pa med pa'i phan cha mdzad pa'i/ srid rtogs yar 'phel du gyur/ mi mthun phyogs pa'i thad du dpa' dpung 'joms pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ yar mar gang du su dang thug kyang*/ jus kyis rgyal kha lon cing*/ nor bu khyung rtse dang*/ g.yul rgyal stag rtse/ stod du ldan dkar rdzong*/ smad du yar 'brog stag lung*/ lho brag skor la sogs/ rdzong bzhi'i/ mnga' zhabs gsar du chod pa mang zhing*/ khri skor brtan lhing gtso bor ston pas/ chen po dgra la byams byas nas//

tha mar dgra bo dbang du sdud/ /mang pos bkur bas kun bskyangs pas/ /kun gyis rgyal po dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid mi gcig pa rnams kyang srid la mthun par byed do/ /'dir sde srid 'dzin pa'i go sa/ mthon por phebs nas/ mnga' zhabs sngar yod rnams/ bo zags med pa'i steng du/ rtsa srid byin po'i gtso bor gyur cing*/ gdan sa chen po dang*/ dpal ldan lha rtse/ mdogamus/ chu 'dus man/ gong dkar/ 'phyongs rgyas stag rtse yan/ 'brel chags su zin na'ang*/ byang phyogs kyi srid po rnams kyang*/ de'i bka' lung dang du len cing*/ de dag thams cad kyi rgyal khrims bdag po/ mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur pas na/ sku lnga'i gzi 'od gsung gis nga ro dang*/ thugs kyis stobs kyi rgyal khrims gnon pa dang*/ phyag rdor gyi sprul pa yin zhes tshig don mthun par grags/ bar pa nang chen rab 'byor 'phags pas/ sa skya nang sor phebs nas ti shri chen po chos rgyal theg chen chos rgyal gyi thog drangs pa'i/ gdung rgyud khu dbon pa'i zhabs tog dang*/ sde srid kyis 'dzin skyong rnams kyang*/ gcen gyis dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i/ rang phyogs la byang sems dang ldan zhing*/ gzhan phyogs su non shin tu che zhes phyi nang kun tu bstod cing smon pa'i gnas su gyur to/ /gcung po dmag dpon bkra shis 'phags pa ni sku gzhon nu nyid nas/ yab mes gong ma rnams kyi mdzad srol dang mthun par/ dgra ri dwags kyi phyogs la zhal bstan pa tsam gyis/ pha rol pham par nus kyis/ jus dang dgra thabs la shin tu phan pas/ dus kun tu g.yul las rgyal ba kho na byung bas na/ dmag dpon rin chen dang chos mtshungs la/ de'i don gyi gnad gang che'i rdzong sa bzung du bzhugs pas/ mnga' zhabs yar 'phel du chod pa/ kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa 'dis/ mi dbang sku mched de rnams kyi dbon sras/ drung bkra shis rab bstan 'phags pa/

dpal bzang po de nyid kyang*/ chos 'brangs khungs nas byung ba yis/ rje btsun gyi yon tan thams cad tshang bas/ chos rgyal chen po'i zhal nas/ 'di ni sde srid kyis bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam par 'gyur ro gsungs shing*/ mdzad 'phrin mthong thos kyi skye bo thams cad kyang mgrin gcig tu bstod cing*/ snyan grags brjod cing sku brtan par bzhugs pa lags so/ /chos rgyal sku mched yab sras mnga' thang dang*/ /blon po sde jus khur gyis mi ngal zhing*/ /zhi drag thabs lam blo gros bang mdzod rgyas/ /sdug bsngal nad gsol sman pa'i rgyal po dang*/ /shes rab spyan ldan 'jam dbyangs dpon btsun dang*/ /sde jus bya ba mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsum/ /'di 'dra'i blon rje na rim bsnan pa yis/ /sde pa su lang 'dug pa mthong ma myong*/ /rje blon shas che sde jus byung ba rnams/ /shes la 'chol dang bcol bas byed pa ste/ /kun la dkon kyang 'di na 'dzaums pa 'di/ /byang sems sprul pa 'di yi sde bar go /'di la smon rnams 'di 'dra mdzad par rigs/ /slar yang rje dpon sku tshe brtan pa dang*/ /zhal ngo 'phel zhing mnga' thang rgyas pa dang*/ /chab srid dar zhing rgyas par shog/ // dge'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/lha dbang sprul pa dpal ldan shar dga'i byung tshul/ -PAGE 202--PAGE 203--PAGE 201-
